name: grokbot-discord-fleet
description: Manage and status MCP + skills for Matthew's Grok Bot Discord fleet (Discord REST + bridge /healthz). Not the wake bridge.

DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN.title: Discord bot token
DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN.description: Bot token for Discord REST reads. Host vault key: DISCORD_FLEET_WAKE. Never commit.

DISCORD_GUILD_ID.title: Default Discord guild ID
DISCORD_GUILD_ID.description: Default guild snowflake for channel/guild status tools. Use a placeholder until configured.

DISCORD_BRIDGE_HEALTH_URL.title: Bridge health URL
DISCORD_BRIDGE_HEALTH_URL.description: Full URL to bridge GET /healthz (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:18083/healthz via SSH tunnel). Optional.
